plans.prompt: First-person point of view. Two hands in dark suit sleeves rest on an empty dark wooden desk in a dim presidential office at night, rain streaking the window behind. A single old beige CRT computer monitor stands on the desk; its dark screen suddenly switches on and glows bright cold blue-white, the blue light spreading over the hands and the desk. Desk lamp off, pen holder. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, slow push-in, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

First-person point of view, extreme close-up on an old beige CRT monitor glowing cold blue-white. A hand rests on a computer mouse and moves it slightly; on screen, a cursor settles over a single plain gray node among a few other gray nodes. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.
